dialogue.origin: 入りました
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm here.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for joining. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: はい、お願いいたします
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 始めさせていただいてよいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Shall we begin?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: あの、
dialogue.content: Um...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 水泳部をやめようかと思って・・・
dialogue.content: I'm thinking about quitting the swim team...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。悩んでおられるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It sounds like you're struggling with this.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: さしつかえなければ、年齢と性別を教えてくださいね。
dialogue.content: If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 16才　女性です
dialogue.content: I'm 16, female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: やめようと思われたのはいつごろからですか？
dialogue.content: How long have you been thinking about quitting?

dialogue.origin: 秋口かな
dialogue.content: Since around the beginning of fall, I think.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ここ２、3か月くらい、しんどい思いをされているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you've been having a difficult time for the past two or three months.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: それはつらいですよね。
dialogue.content: That must be hard.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なにかきっかけになるような出来事があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Was there any particular event that triggered this?

dialogue.origin: 他にやらなきゃいけない事もあるし、続けられないかな、って
dialogue.content: I have other things I need to do, so I'm not sure I can keep going.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・本当はやめたくないのかな？
dialogue.content: I see... Maybe you don't really want to quit?

dialogue.origin: うん
dialogue.content: Yeah.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。今とてもつらい状況なんですね。
dialogue.content: I understand. You're in a very tough situation right now.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ほかにやらなくてはいけないことって、どのようなことですか？
dialogue.content: What are these other things you need to do?

dialogue.origin: うーん、お家のこととか、かな
dialogue.content: Um, things at home, I guess.

dialogue.origin: お家のこと・・・何か事情があるのですね。ここでお話することはできそうですか？
dialogue.content: Things at home... It sounds like there's something going on. Do you feel comfortable talking about it?

dialogue.origin: 話しにくいけど、いいかな
dialogue.content: It's a little difficult to talk about, but... I think I can.

dialogue.origin: もしお話しできそうだったら、聞かせてくださいね。
dialogue.content: If you feel you can, please share it with me.

dialogue.origin: ママが忙しいから、大変だし.…
dialogue.content: My mom is busy, so it's tough...

dialogue.origin: お金もかかるし…
dialogue.content: And it costs money, too...

dialogue.origin: やめようかな
dialogue.content: Maybe I should quit.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お母さんのことを心配されているのですね。経済的な面で負担をかけたくないと思っているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You're concerned about your mother, and you don't want to be a financial burden on her.

dialogue.origin: でも、水泳部はこれまでがんばってきたのですよね？
dialogue.content: But you've worked so hard on the swim team up until now, haven't you?

dialogue.origin: 水泳なら道具そんなに要らないし、続けてきたんだけどね
dialogue.content: Well, swimming doesn't require much equipment, so I've been able to continue with it, but...

dialogue.origin: やめた方がいいかな
dialogue.content: Maybe it's better if I quit.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。水泳部を選んだのもお金がかからないからだったんだね。とても気を使ってきたんですね。やめることについて、お母さんには相談したのかな？
dialogue.content: I see. So you chose the swim team partly because it wasn't expensive. You've been very thoughtful. Have you discussed quitting with your mother?

dialogue.origin: 泳ぐのは好きだけど、うちのお母さんは応援には来てくれる事はなかったけど、辞めるって言ったら
dialogue.content: I like swimming, but my mom has never come to cheer me on. If I tell her I'm quitting,

dialogue.origin: そんなには反対はしないかも。
dialogue.content: she probably wouldn't be that against it.

dialogue.origin: 言わないにしようかな
dialogue.content: Maybe I just won't say anything.

dialogue.origin: まだ相談はしていないのですね。
dialogue.content: So you haven't talked with her about it yet.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: みにさん（とお呼びしてよいでしょうか）は泳ぐことが好きでやめたくないと思っているようですし、一度お母さんに相談してみてもよいと思うのですが、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Mini-san (is it okay if I call you that?), it seems you enjoy swimming and don't really want to quit. I think it might be a good idea to try talking to your mother about it. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: うーん、辞めれば、って言われそうだな
dialogue.content: Hmm... I feel like she'd just tell me to quit.

dialogue.origin: なんだか、、、
dialogue.content: I don't know...

dialogue.origin: 辞めてもいいかなとも思ってる
dialogue.content: I'm also starting to think maybe it's fine if I quit.

dialogue.origin: その方が、みんな助かるし
dialogue.content: That way, it would help everyone.

dialogue.origin: みにさんはみんなのために辞めようかな、と思っているのですね。みにさんはお家のことで今どういうことが一番心配ですか？
dialogue.content: So, Mini-san, you're thinking of quitting for the sake of everyone else. Regarding your home situation, what is your biggest concern right now?

dialogue.origin: お母さんが、毎日仕事で大変だし、機嫌も悪い。おばあちゃんの面倒も見れないくらいで、
dialogue.content: My mom has a hard time with work every day, and she's always in a bad mood. It's gotten to the point where she can't even look after my grandmother.

dialogue.origin: ほっとできない
dialogue.content: I can't relax.

dialogue.origin: おばあちゃんも同居されているのですね。家でも気持ちが休まらないと疲れてしまいますね・・・
dialogue.content: So your grandmother lives with you as well. It must be exhausting not being able to relax, even at home.

dialogue.origin: お母さんも機嫌がよくないのもつらいですね。
dialogue.content: And it must be difficult for you when your mother is in a bad mood.

dialogue.origin: 気も休まらないし、体も休まらないんです
dialogue.content: I can't get any rest, mentally or physically.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。それは毎日しんどいと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be tough every day.

dialogue.origin: しんどいです
dialogue.content: It is tough.

dialogue.origin: では、部活で泳ぐことが気分転換になっていたのではないですか？
dialogue.content: Then, wasn't swimming at your club a way for you to unwind and take your mind off things?

dialogue.origin: だけど、冬季は水にはなかなか入れないし、やめるにはいい時期かもね
dialogue.content: But we don't get in the water much during the winter, so maybe it's a good time to quit.

dialogue.origin: 早く帰れば、おばあちゃんもお母さんも助かるしね
dialogue.content: And if I go home earlier, it would help both my mom and my grandma.

dialogue.origin: そのように思い始めているんですね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you've started to see it.

dialogue.origin: やっぱりその方がいいですよね？
dialogue.content: That would be better, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、どちらがいいかということはやっぱりみにさん自身が決めていいと思うんですよ。
dialogue.content: Well, I think it's ultimately up to you to decide which is better.

dialogue.origin: 水泳部をやめた生活と部活を続けた生活、想像してみて、どちらがよさそうに思いますか？
dialogue.content: If you imagine your life after quitting the swim team versus continuing with it, which one seems better to you?

dialogue.origin: うーん、辞めると、毎日毎日、お家の事と、おばあちゃんのお世話、、、苦しくなってくる
dialogue.content: Hmm, if I quit, it would be chores and taking care of my grandma every single day... that would become suffocating.

dialogue.origin: だけど、お母さんは楽になるし、お金もかからないから、
dialogue.content: But it would be easier for my mom, and we wouldn't have to spend the money,

dialogue.origin: きっと喜ぶのかもしれない
dialogue.content: so she'd probably be happy about it.

dialogue.origin: そうか・・・部活をやめると家に帰ってお家のお手伝いをたくさんすることになりそうですね。でもお母さんは喜んでくれるのかな。
dialogue.content: I see... So if you quit the team, it seems you'd end up helping out a lot at home. But would your mother really be happy about that?

dialogue.origin: だって、毎日、イライラしてるんだもん
dialogue.content: Well, she's frustrated every single day.

dialogue.origin: でも、みにさんは好きな水泳ができなくて、楽しさは少なくなりそうですね。
dialogue.content: But you wouldn't be able to swim, which you love, and it sounds like your life would have less joy in it.

dialogue.origin: 続けたら
dialogue.content: If I keep going...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。毎日お母さんがイライラしている姿は見たくないですよね。
dialogue.content: That's right. You don't want to see your mother frustrated every day.

dialogue.origin: 続けたら、どうなりそうですか？
dialogue.content: If you were to continue, what do you think would happen?

dialogue.origin: お母さんの機嫌がもっと酷くなって、、、
dialogue.content: My mom's mood would get even worse...

dialogue.origin: 怖い
dialogue.content: It's scary.

dialogue.origin: もっと機嫌が悪くなって、想像すると怖いかな・・・
dialogue.content: Imagining her getting even more irritable feels scary...

dialogue.origin: 私が悪いからだね
dialogue.content: It's my fault.

dialogue.origin: お母さんはみにさんが悪い、と思うんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you think your mother would feel that you are to blame?

dialogue.origin: 辞めればきっとお母さんは喜ぶんだよね
dialogue.content: If I quit, my mom will surely be happy.

dialogue.origin: だって
dialogue.content: Because—

dialogue.origin: おばあちゃんのお世話が間に合ってないと、物凄く怒鳴られるんだもん
dialogue.content: If I don't keep up with caring for my grandma, she yells at me really harshly.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは怖いですね・・・
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very frightening.

dialogue.origin: でも本当は泳ぐことが好きで、やめたくない気持ちもあるのですよね？
dialogue.content: But deep down, you like swimming and there's a part of you that doesn't want to quit, right?

dialogue.origin: だけどお母さんをこれ以上怒らせるのなら、やめた方がいいのかな、とも思う
dialogue.content: But if it means making my mom even angrier, then I think it might be better to quit.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。みにさんはこれ以上お母さんを怒らせたくない、できれば喜ばせてあげたいという気持ちがあるのですね。でも泳ぐことは好きという気持ちもある。
dialogue.content: I understand. You don't want to make your mother any more upset; you'd rather make her happy if you can. But you also love to swim.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話を聞いていて、私が感じたことを少しお伝えしてもよいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: May I share a little of what I've felt from listening to you so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: お母さんはとても忙しくて機嫌が悪く、みにさんはお家でも休まらない。水泳は好きだけど、みんなのためには辞めたほうがいいと思っているのですね。
dialogue.content: Your mother is very busy and often in a bad mood, and you can't relax at home. You love swimming, but you feel it would be better for everyone if you quit.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: でもまだお母さんには相談していないとのこと。相談したら辞めたらといわれそうなんですよね。
dialogue.content: But you haven't spoken to your mother about it yet. And you're afraid she would just tell you to quit if you did.

dialogue.origin: はいそう思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.origin: 水泳部を続けながら、お母さんの負担を少しでも楽にしてあげられるような方法がないか、考えてみるというのはどうでしょうか。
dialogue.content: What if we tried to think of a way for you to continue with the swim team while also finding ways to ease your mother's burden, even slightly?

dialogue.origin: そんな事、できるのかな？
dialogue.content: Is that even possible?

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・・みにさんはさきほど冬はシーズンオフで泳げないというお話をされていましたね。
dialogue.content: Well... you mentioned earlier that you can't swim much during the winter off-season, right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 例えばシーズンオフはできるだけお家のお手伝いをするから、プールを使えるようになったら部活動を優先させてほしい、というような話し合いをお母さんをするというのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: For example, what about talking to your mother and suggesting a compromise? You could offer to help around the house as much as possible during the off-season, in exchange for her letting you prioritize your club activities once you can use the pool again.

dialogue.origin: ちょっと、勇気がいりそう
dialogue.content: That would take a bit of courage.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。どんな反応がくるのか、怖い気持ちもありますよね。
dialogue.content: Right. Not knowing how she'll respond can feel scary.

dialogue.origin: コロナでクビになるかもとか言ってたりして、機嫌は最悪
dialogue.content: She's been saying things like she might get laid off because of COVID, so her mood is terrible.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。ぴりぴりした雰囲気なんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So the atmosphere at home is very tense.

dialogue.origin: でも、みにさんがそんなふうにお家やお母さんのことを心配している、ということを伝えることで、お母さんもみにさんの一生懸命悩んでいる気持ちを感じてくれるのではないかと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: But I think that by letting your mother know how much you worry about her and your family, she might realize how seriously you've been grappling with this.

dialogue.origin: そうだといいけど
dialogue.content: I hope so.

dialogue.origin: 悩んでいるということをそのまま伝えてもよいのではないかと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: I think it's okay to just tell her exactly that—that you're struggling.

dialogue.origin: それもそうかな
dialogue.content: Maybe you're right.

dialogue.origin: はい。もしかしてお母さんはみにさんが家のことを全く考えずに、自分のことばかり考えていると思っているかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: Yes. It's possible your mother might think you're only thinking of yourself, without any consideration for the family.

dialogue.origin: あ、そうかも
dialogue.content: Oh, that could be it.

dialogue.origin: こんなにお母さんのことを心配して悩んでいるのにね。
dialogue.content: Even though you care and worry about her this much.

dialogue.origin: おばあちゃんのことはもっと心配だけどね
dialogue.content: I'm even more worried about my grandma, though.

dialogue.origin: うん、そうですね。みにさんは本当に家族思いでやさしいんですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. You're a very kind and caring person, so thoughtful of your family.

dialogue.origin: 私がいないと困るからね
dialogue.content: They'd be in trouble without me.

dialogue.origin: 今もすでに家族の一員として活躍しているんですね！おばあちゃんのことも心配って、お母さんに伝えてみてください。そういうみにさんの気持ちを知って、お母さんはみにさんの成長をきっと喜んでくれると思いますよ。
dialogue.content: You're already playing such an important role in your family! Try telling your mother that you're worried about your grandmother, too. I'm sure that when your mother understands how you feel, she'll be happy to see how much you've matured.

dialogue.origin: そっか、だといいな
dialogue.content: I see. That would be nice.

dialogue.origin: はい、きっと伝わると思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm sure your feelings will get through to her.

dialogue.origin: 好きなことを全部諦める必要はないと思うんですよ。
dialogue.content: I don't think you have to give up on everything you love.

dialogue.origin: そうか
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いつでも家族と相談しながら、協力しながらできることをやっていけばよいのだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think you can just focus on doing what you can, while always talking and cooperating with your family.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お家のこと、大変だと思うけれど、家族で協力しながら頑張ってほしいなと思います。お母さんに相談できそうですか？
dialogue.content: I know things at home are difficult, but I hope you can all work together as a family. Do you feel like you'll be able to talk to your mother?

dialogue.origin: ご機嫌次第かなー
dialogue.content: I guess it depends on her mood.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。機嫌のよさそうなときに話をするということがポイントですね！
dialogue.content: That's right. The key is to talk to her when she seems to be in a good mood!

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: みにさんはお母さんの様子をとてもよく見ておられるので、ぜひ、機嫌のよさそうだなってときに、思い切って話をしてみてください。
dialogue.content: You're very attentive to your mother's mood, so please try to take the plunge and talk with her when she seems to be in a good mood.

dialogue.origin: はいわかりました
dialogue.content: Okay, I will.

dialogue.origin: 今日のご相談はこのあたりでおわらせていただいても大丈夫そうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if we wrap up our session for today?

dialogue.origin: はい、うまくいかなかったら、また来ていいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. If it doesn't go well, can I come back and talk again?

dialogue.origin: もちろんです！また何か相談したいことがあればいつでも話に来てくださいね。勇気をだしてがんばってみてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Of course! Please feel free to come back anytime you have something you want to discuss. Gather your courage and give it a try.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、お話を聞かせてくださってありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: No, thank you for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.origin: （すみません、時間がオーバーしてしまいました。今日はありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry, we've gone over our time. Thank you for today.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。勉強になりました、お疲れ様です！
dialogue.content: Thank you. This has been very helpful. Thank you for your time!

dialogue.origin: お疲れさまでした！ありがとうございました。終了いたしますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time as well. I'll end the session now.

topic.sub: 母親とのコミュニケーション問題
